softwareInnerHero.title: Revolutionizing Cybersecurity
paragraphs: Palo Alto Networks is the global cybersecurity leader, known for pioneering next-generation firewall technology and delivering innovative security solutions that protect organizations from cyber threats across all environments.

Our integrated platform approach provides comprehensive security from network to cloud to endpoint, enabling organizations to safely adopt new technologies and protect their digital assets with confidence.
With our AI-powered security automation and industry-leading threat intelligence, we help organizations prevent successful cyberattacks and secure their digital transformation journey.

items.title: AI-Powered Security
items.body: Machine learning and AI capabilities that detect and respond to threats faster and more accurately than traditional security solutions.

items.title: Zero Trust Architecture
items.body: Comprehensive zero trust security model that verifies every user and device, regardless of location, before granting access.

items.title: Automated Security Operations
items.body: Automate threat detection, investigation, and response to reduce manual workloads and improve security team efficiency.

items.title: Threat Intelligence
items.body: Unit 42 threat intelligence provides real-time insights into emerging threats and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures.

items.title: Cloud-Native Security
items.body: Security solutions designed specifically for cloud environments, providing protection across multi-cloud and hybrid architectures.

items.title: Integrated Platform
items.body: Seamless integration between security products enables sharing of threat intelligence and coordinated response across the entire attack surface.
